name: VolunteerProjects - Populated Grid
description: The open-projects section with three projects — the state /volunteer reaches once organizers post work in the CMS. Every card now links through to its own detail page, and the mix is deliberate: one project with a photo and a sign-up form, one with a photo but no form yet, and one with neither. All three cards stay the same height, which is what keeps a mixed grid aligned.
